plan.title: Auction dynamic extension trigger below one minute

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation flow.
Switch the event type to a buy auction using the supported auction configuration.
Select the reverse/buy auction template so the pricing sheet is generated.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Complete the auction pricing sheet for the line item.

args.goal: On the auction create screen, set the first line item's Plant Name or delivery location to LOC-0001, enable dynamic time extension, set its trigger to 0.5 minute, and leave the screen ready for the remaining setup.

steps.note: No catalog step exposes the dynamic-extension trigger or the requested plant-location interaction, so perform those buyer-side screen actions directly.
Add the two vendors required by the scenario without inventing vendor names.
Attempt to publish the configured auction.

args.contains: Trigger time extension cannot be less than 1 min
